chunks: Abu Ali Al-Ash'ari, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Husayn ibn Zayd, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'There is no group of people who gather in a gathering and do not mention the Name of Allah, Exalted and Majestic, and do not send blessings upon their Prophet, except that that gathering becomes a regret and a burden upon them.'
ai.seo_question: What is the consequence of a gathering that does not mention Allah and the Prophet?
ai.summary: Recorded in al-Kafi, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (as) establishes dhikr and salawat as the defining spiritual markers of a Muslim gathering, transforming social interaction into an act of worship. It underscores the Shia emphasis on the Prophet’s family and the Prophet himself as the focal point of divine remembrance, warning that their omission leads to 'hasrah' (regret) and 'wabāl' (consequence) on the Day of Judgment.
